title: चीरहरण उपन्यासकी प्रमुख पात्र द्रौपदीको शैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययन {Draupadi, the main character of the Chihararan novel, is a stylist Study}
nepali: प्रस्तुत आलेख नीलम कार्की निहारिकाको चीरहरण उपन्यासमा प्रयुक्त पात्र द्र्रौपदीको शैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययनमा आधारित छ । उपन्यासमा द्रौपदीको के कस्तो भूमिका रह्यो भन्ने कुराको पहिचान गर्नु यस अध्ययनको मूल समस्या हो । यस अध्ययनमा पात्र विश्लेषण गर्ने सैद्धान्तिक आधार शैलीविज्ञानलाई बनाइएको छ । चीरहरण उपन्यासलाई नै मूल स्रोत सामग्रीको रूपमा प्रयोग गरी वर्णनात्मक र विश्लेषणात्मक विधिको अवलम्बन गरी अध्ययनलाई निष्कर्षमा पुर्याइएको छ । यस क्रममा प्रस्तुत लेखमा नीलम कार्की निहारिकाको परिचय, शैलीविज्ञानको संक्षिप्त परिचय पात्र वर्गीकरण गर्ने शैलीवैज्ञानिक आधारका साथै चीरहरण उपन्यासकी पात्र द्रौपदीले उपन्यासमा निर्वाह गरेको भूमिका तथा स्थानको पहिचान गरिएको छ । {The present article is based on the stylistic study of the character Draupadi used in Neelam Karki Niharika's novel Chiraharan. Identifying role of Draupadi played in the novel is the main problem of this study. The theoretical basis for character analysis in this study is stylistics. The study concludes with the use of descriptive and analytical methods, using the novel as its original source material. In this article, the introduction of Neelam Karki Niharika, a brief introduction of stylistics, the stylistic basis for classifying the characters as well as the role and place of Draupadi, the character of the novel Chiraharan, have been identified.}
american_english: The present article is based on a stylistic study of the character Draupadi used in Neelam Karki Niharika's novel Chiraharan. Identifying what kind of role Draupadi played in the novel is the main problem of this study. In this study, stylistics has been made the theoretical basis for analyzing characters. Using the novel Chiraharan itself as the primary source material and adopting descriptive and analytical methods, the study has been brought to its conclusions. In this course, the present article has identified the introduction of Neelam Karki Niharika, a brief introduction to stylistics, the stylistic basis for classifying characters, as well as the role and place that Draupadi, the character of the novel Chiraharan, fulfilled in the novel.
british_english: The present article is based upon a stylistic study of the character Draupadi as she appears in Neelam Karki Niharika's novel Chiraharan. Establishing what part Draupadi played in the novel is the central problem of this study. In this study, stylistics has been adopted as the theoretical basis for the analysis of character. Employing the novel Chiraharan itself as the principal source of material and adopting a descriptive and analytical method, the study has been brought to its conclusion. In the course of this, the present article identifies an introduction to Neelam Karki Niharika, a brief introduction to stylistics, the stylistic criteria for classifying characters, together with an identification of the role and station fulfilled in the novel by Draupadi, the character of the novel Chiraharan.
australian_english: This article is based on a stylistic study of the character Draupadi in Neelam Karki Niharika's novel Chiraharan. Pinning down what sort of role Draupadi plays in the novel is the core problem of this study. In this study, stylistics has been used as the theoretical basis for analysing characters. Taking the novel Chiraharan itself as the main source material and using a descriptive and analytical approach, the study has been carried through to its findings. Along the way, this article sets out an introduction to Neelam Karki Niharika, a brief run-through of stylistics, the stylistic basis for grouping characters, plus an identification of the role and place taken on in the novel by Draupadi, the character from Chiraharan.
informal_english: So this article's a stylistic look at Draupadi, the character in Neelam Karki Niharika's novel Chiraharan. Figuring out just what Draupadi gets up to in the novel is the main thing this study's trying to sort out. Stylistics is the theoretical tool they've used to break the character down. Chiraharan itself is the main source, and by going descriptive and analytical they've got the study wrapped up. Along the way, the article covers an intro to Neelam Karki Niharika, a quick rundown of stylistics, the stylistic way of sorting characters into groups, and it pins down the role and place Draupadi takes up in the novel.
